description: Reaching this means the store failed to OPEN: it opens before the daemon registers its methods, so a running daemon without memory has already printed the reason on stdout. `fatal: true` — nothing a client retries will fix it.

data.what: this daemon has no store, so nothing can be read or written
data.means: the store opens before the daemon registers its methods, so reaching this means the open failed and the daemon is running without memory
